meta.source: Servicio Nacional de Aduanas, export declarations (DUS), open data on datos.gob.cl — anonymised: no exporter name
meta.unit: tonnes net product weight, thousand USD FOB
meta.linking: exporters are renumbered every month; each one is chained from month to month by its own product reference codes, then by its town, species and forms, destinations, regions of origin and size. A chain may break when an exporter changes its references: read it as a likely continuity, not a certainty.
meta.sizes_note: weight class written in the product description (calibre), mid-point, converted from lb when needed; whole fish are mostly gutted head-on (HON) weight; fillets are fillet weight
